Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette/bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt) & 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & paneer curry (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (onion & tomato & lemon & salt)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (hand-roasted in ghee) (salt & chilli powder)
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 2: Clear chicken soup (simple) & curd (small cup)

Notes_and_Tips: For fat loss, body shape & confidence: keep rice portions around 1 cup cooked (~150 g) per main meal and make protein the main (chicken/eggs/paneer) for better satiety.
Sleep is your biggest lever: aim for an earlier dinner and a consistent bedtime to reduce stress eating.
Spicy cravings: add spice to main meals (curry/omelette) instead of adding extra snacks.
Busy workday: keep murmura or roasted makhana pre-portioned to avoid random snacking.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing support stable energy and easier fat loss.
